text:
Ari (sales): Heads-up 11 Nova Medica wants a 14-day POC for their nova-medica-30b-ft variant. Asking: catalog onboarding, perf targets, and BYOK/VPC support. Can we triage?
Ben (SE): Got it. Quick Qs: full checkpoint or sharded safetensors? any adapters/LoRA? tokenizer changes? expected seq lengths + traffic profile?
Marta (Nova Medica): artifact = 30B sharded safetensors (4 shards). Two lightweight LoRA adapters (clinical-summ, triage). Tokenizer = sentencepiece with 4 extra clinical tokens. Workload: steady 70 rps, burst 320 rps; typical seq 128-1.5k, occasional 10k imaging reports. Require VPC + BYOK; HIPAA covered.
Lina (solutions): Proposed triage steps: 1) tokenizer parity + sample tokenization examples 2) LoRA fuse test -> ensure no offset changes to special tokens 3) run 1.5k and 10k generate profiles for KV/memory growth 4) sharded load stress to check OOM/restart behavior 5) staging perf run for p95 token lat at 70/320 rps.
Ben (SE): Add: verify quant path (FP16 -> PTQ int8) and fusion compatibility with our quant kernels. Also collect sample distribution so we can estimate batching benefits.
Ben (SE): staging upload command:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/models/compat-upload 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" 
  -F "artifact=@nova_medica_30b_sharded.tar.gz" 
  -F "adapters=@lora_adapters.zip" 
  -F "samples=@nova_samples.zip"
```
Ari (sales): Marta 1 can you include 12 tokenization examples (plain -> tokenized), label PHI vs non-PHI, and add one long 10k doc? That will help debug token inflation.
Marta (Nova Medica): Will upload today. Also want a rough pricing comparison: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for expected profile (70 steady, burst to 320).
Lina (solutions): Preliminary note: if most requests <512 tokens, hosted may be cheaper; lots of 10k contexts favors Dedicated/Private with larger memory nodes. I'll run a detailed estimator after we see sequence histogram.
Harold (security): Security intake checklist: completed vendor questionnaire, KMS ARN(s) for BYOK, data flow diagram, retention policies, SOC2/HIPAA attestation. For PHI we require: VPC-only routing, BYOK, and disable external telemetry for PHI-tagged requests. Marta 1 do you require per-tenant keys or a single tenant key?
Marta (Nova Medica): Per-tenant keys preferred. Also strict audit logging and a 90-day retention cap.
Harold (security): Noted. We support per-tenant KMS but need ARNs and IAM roles. Also will prepare PHI addendum draft for legal. Please fill: https://redwood.internal/sec-forms/nova-medica-poc (sections A-C).
InfraBot: scheduled compat-run job #compat-3001 for 2026-04-08T07:00:00Z (staging). Estimated runtime: 55m.
Ben (SE): Perf expectations ballpark: 30B + fused LoRA on A100-ish int8 -> p95 token latency ~90-150ms for <=512 tokens with batching. For 1.5k expect higher p95, 10k full-context calls will be dominated by KV transfer and memory and could be seconds. We'll post measured numbers after the compat run.
Lina (solutions): Fallback policy proposal: non-PHI -> route to distilled 13B variant during capacity pressure; PHI-tagged -> enforce private-only routing to BYOK nodes. Marta 1 acceptable?
Marta (Nova Medica): Acceptable for non-PHI. PHI must always stay Private. Also want a target SLA: 95p token latency ~80ms. Is that realistic?
Ben (SE): 80ms p95 for 30B int8 is aggressive. With dedicated high-memory nodes and tight batching we might approach 80-100ms for short sequences; will provide concrete numbers post-run and caveat for long-context.
Harold (security): Enforcement note: metadata.sensitivity="phi" -> route_policy=private-only; disable telemetry + redact logs. We'll draft the enforcement rule and addendum.
Ari (sales): Owners: samples & artifact (Marta), compat & perf tests (Ben), pricing + commit options (Lina), security intake + addendum (Harold). Timeline: Marta uploads today -> tests tomorrow -> initial perf + pricing by EoW.
Ben (SE): Reminder: include tokenization examples that show the clinical tokens adjacent to other punctuation (we've seen token splits cause +20-30% token inflation).
Marta (Nova Medica): Uploading now. Thanks team! :rocket:
